name: microbin
title: MicroBin
description: Paste bin for text and files with expiry times, burn after reading, password protection, short links and QR codes. Anyone who can open it can make a paste. After deploying, the admin page at /admin opens with the user name and password you set below.

variables.name: MICROBIN_PUBLIC_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://paste.example.com. The link and QR code of every paste are built from it. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above
